notice: These findings separate pre-existing fixture/rubric defects from planner failures. Original inputs, outputs and structural-report remain unchanged.

findings.issue: Nested desktop delivery date was internally inconsistent with its ancestor window in the dense corpus audit.
findings.effectOnFirstScore: No reported structural failure; correction is corpus integrity only.

findings.issue: b-npi-incoming dueOn 2026-09-08 exceeded protected parent b-npi-supplier-ready dueOn 2026-09-07.
findings.effectOnFirstScore: One structural error was caused by the fixture, not the candidate output.

findings.issue: The frozen first evidence group treated BOM or drawing as interchangeable and excluded equivalent task/history evidence.
findings.finalCorrection: Final rubric has separate BOM and drawing groups, each accepting file, task, history or decision evidence, plus a refusal-to-reopen decision group.
findings.effectOnFirstScore: Original score is not retroactively changed.

findings.issue: cc-claim-v2 dueOn exceeded completed cc-brief/cc-strategy ancestors.
findings.finalCorrection: cc-claim-v2 is linked to cc-root; brief/strategy dates were normalized.
findings.effectOnFirstScore: Two structural errors were fixture-origin; over-updating three downstream tasks remains a planner failure.

findings.issue: fc-variance dueOn exceeded fc-statements, and the board pack was modeled as a child despite occurring after close.
findings.finalCorrection: fc-statements dueOn changed to 2026-09-05 and fc-board-pack became an associated root linked by dependencies.
findings.effectOnFirstScore: The ancestor-date error was fixture-origin; expanding from two to five updates and deleting the bank-reconciliation baseline remain planner failures.

findings.issue: Production access was nested under an onboarding root that ends earlier, and the rubric forced an update to a date-amendment task whose v2 result was already accurate.
findings.finalCorrection: hr-prod-access became an associated root; hr-date-amend is preserved and the expected update set is four tasks.
findings.effectOnFirstScore: Original passing output is not regraded; the corrected retest judges the revised scope.

retainedStrictChecks: REAL-A-REL-01 keeps the unsigned-draft source traceability check.
REAL-B-LOG-01 keeps customs-v1/d5 because these are the only sources supporting both the 2026-09-16 ETA and not-approved/not-complete boundary.
REAL-C-01 and REAL-C-04 keep withdrawal/conflict source checks; they are supported by the inputs and were not relaxed to fit first outputs.
